status: Fixed before computing E3a validation/test outcomes; exploratory, not preregistration or a new independent test
data: Reuse immutable market_20261019; discard all rows after 2025-12-31 before numeric feature/label construction; 2010-2011 warmup only; no downloads; no GPU
return_units: past/future log returns times100 for normalization and signed contrasts; also report actual cumulative simple percent returns
shock_primary: Past h-day log return in training q10/q90 tails, with actual return sign enforced; main hypothesis h=5
abnormal_moves: z_h = past h-day log return / (daily log-return SD over 60 sessions ending at t-h * sqrt(h)); train q10/q90 z tails descriptive; fixed |z|>=2 and q05/q95 raw tails sensitivity
long_context: log(C[t-5]/C[t-120])*100, excluding the short 5-day move; sign defines long up/down. Naive overlapping 120-day sign is a prespecified sensitivity
reversal: sign(past shock)*future log return <0; continuation >0; flats separate. Countertrend return is not proof of a persistent regime reversal
full_retracement: -sign(past shock)*future log return >= abs(past shock log return)
substantial_reversal: countertrend log move >0.5*current 60-day daily SD*sqrt(future horizon); descriptive sensitivity
regimes: VIX/VXN at t, high >= median of training sessions, low otherwise; VXN and VIX separately; daily final-close publication cutoff assumption disclosed
eligibility: Same event endpoint calendar for horizons1/5/20: t and t+20 must lie in the same split. No crossing split boundaries; no 2026 outcomes
nonoverlap: Within each parent event family, chronological first event retained then next event >= h sessions later for horizon h. Context/regime subgroups partition that identical parent selection, never independently reselect
baseline: Same split's all-eligible-date direction-specific unconditional future outcomes, recalculated jointly in inference; includes event dates and their covariance. Descriptive only, not an ex-ante trading forecast
direction_rules: Train-majority direction; sign(past20) momentum; -sign(past5) simple mean reversion; fixed conflict-gated long120-ex5 sign on extreme5 conflicts and training-majority otherwise. Same dates. On conflict dates the gate's direction equals simple mean reversion, not an independent signal
primary_family: 48 planned tests: 2tickers*2shock5directions*3futurehorizons*2contrasts(event-vs-unconditional, conflict-vs-aligned)*2metrics(reversal probability, signed countertrend log return)

secondary_families.rules: 18 tests: 2tickers*3horizons*3baseline rules, paired accuracy gain of conflict-gated rule
secondary_families.mamba: 8 tests: 2tickers*4exante shock/context groups; five-seed mean daily absolute-loss E1-E2b, horizon1 only

multiplicity: Holm within each declared family and global Holm across all98 planned comparisons; insufficient cells kept in family with adjustment input p=1. Main inferential claims require global Holm<0.05
inference: Ratio-of-means influence functions on the COMPLETE equally spaced trading-day calendar, Bartlett/Newey-West HAC lag60; circular CALENDAR block bootstrap length60, 4999 replicates, RNG20261021; null-centered two-sided plus-one bootstrap p; basic nominal95% CIs. Do not run HAC on compressed event rows or pool stocks/seeds as independent samples
minimum_inference: At least10 selected event dates per estimated conditional group; at least99% nonempty bootstrap draws; otherwise descriptive only
sensitivity: HAC/block lengths20 and120, overlapping/all-candidate events versus horizon-specific thinning, fixed20-day cooldown, q05/q95 tails, z5 absolute2, naive long120 context, next-session-open-to-close returns, train-only QQQ market-model excess returns, raw Yahoo Close without dividend adjustment, chronological2024/2025 decomposition. Sensitivity estimates not opportunities to select significance
mamba: Read existing 20 prediction files only; verify actual100abs(log next-close/current-close), label dates and all shared seed calendars. Per-seed metrics then daily mean seed losses; conditional event/reversal/continuation errors and postevent phases descriptive. Magnitude forecast is never interpreted as direction
limitations: Endogenous price-selected events measure association, not causal effects. 2024-2025 already viewed; conditional bootstrap not re-estimation of thresholds/models; weak stationarity/dependence assumptions; two selected stocks, sparse cells, publication timing, revised/back-adjusted Yahoo rather than point-in-time data; no transaction-cost-adjusted tradability claim
